# Sicily Driver Siracusa

> Licensed private driver service (NCC) based in Syracuse, Sicily, Italy. Airport
> and port transfers, full-day private tours and wedding transport across eastern
> Sicily, with English-, French- and Italian-speaking drivers and luxury vans.
> Operating 24/7. Rated 4.9/5 from 32 reviews. VAT IT02150600894.

Sicily Driver Siracusa is run by Vincenzo Izzo. Bookings are agreed at a flat rate
before departure, with no surcharges added afterwards. Airport pickups include
flight tracking, a name sign at the arrivals exit and up to 60 minutes of free
waiting after landing. Payment by cash, credit card or bank transfer.

Bases: Syracuse (Via della Maestranza 28), Noto (Via Alcide De Gasperi 15),
Marzamemi (Via Marzamemi 23).
Areas served: Syracuse, Ortigia, Noto, Avola, Marzamemi, Catania, Taormina,
Ragusa, Modica, Val di Noto and eastern Sicily (roughly a 150 km radius).
Vehicles: Mercedes V-Class, GLB Premium and E-Class.
Contact: info@ncctaxisiracusa.com · WhatsApp +39 375 641 3379

Site languages: English (/en), Italian (site root), French (/fr). The pages below
link to the English version; swap the prefix for the other languages.

## Airport and port transfers

- [Transfers overview](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/sicily-airport-port-transfers): all routes from the airports of Catania, Comiso, Palermo and Trapani and the port of Pozzallo.
- [Catania Airport to Syracuse](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/catania-syracuse-transfer): about 50 minutes. From €90 per trip for 1–3 passengers, €120 from 4 passengers.
- [Catania Airport to Noto](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/catania-noto-transfer): direct transfer to Noto and the Val di Noto.
- [Catania Airport to Taormina](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/catania-taormina-transfer): transfer along the Ionian coast.
- [Pozzallo Port to Syracuse](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/pozzallo-syracuse-transfer): connection from the Malta ferry terminal.

## Private tours

- [Sicily tours overview](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/sicily-tours): all full-day and half-day private tours with a dedicated driver.
- [Baroque Tour](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/baroque-tour): full day across Noto, Modica and Ragusa Ibla, the UNESCO late-Baroque towns of the Val di Noto.
- [Etna Premium](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/tour/etna-premium): Mount Etna day tour including the Silvestri craters at about 1,900 m, with quad option and tasting.
- [Isola delle Correnti](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/tour/isola-delle-correnti): day tour to the southernmost point of Sicily, where the Ionian and Mediterranean seas meet.
- [Dolce Vita Ortigia](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/tour/dolce-vita-siracusa): three-hour Ortigia tour in a vintage Fiat 500 Spiaggina.
- [Silent Sailing](https://ncctaxisiracusa.com/en/tour/silent-sailing): private sailing trip from Ortigia along the Syracuse coast.
